drums.tags: Experimental percussion ensemble piece. The arrangement features a variety of wooden and metallic idiophones including woodblocks, temple blocks, and cowbells. A prominent, resonant wooden percussion instrument performs a syncopated, rhythmic ostinato. High-pitched, metallic accents from a cowbell or similar metal plate provide sharp, staccato counter-rhythms. The tempo is approximately 112 BPM. The piece is characterized by a dry acoustic environment with minimal artificial reverb, emphasizing the natural decay of the wooden blocks. The rhythmic structure is built on interlocking polyrhythms between the high-pitched woodblocks and the mid-range temple blocks.
